```{r}
#Setting data formats, calculating u and v components and correcting to SE wind component.
w2 <- w %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime2 = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime2),
         year = year(date)) %>%
  # filter(year > 2021) %>% 
  select(date, measurementTime = measurementTime2,
         ws = WindSpd_Avg, wd = WindDir_Avg) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Convert to meteorological convention (direction wind is coming FROM)
    # u = eastward component, v = northward component
    u = -ws * sin(wd * pi/180),  # Negative because wd is "from" direction
    v = -ws * cos(wd * pi/180),
    # Calculate SE component for each hourly observation
    se_component = (u - v) / sqrt(2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ws:se_component), values_to = "val", names_to = "par") %>% 
  group_by(date, par) %>%
  summarise(dm = mean(val, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

#Pivoting wider for joining with other data
w2_wide <- w2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "par", values_from = "dm") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate(c_sum = cumsum(se_component)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
b2 <- b %>% 
  select(date = date_corr, fl_med_day, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) %>%

  mutate(group = as.character(group))

# Create a temporary dataset with dates of a the 2024 SB data gap.
gap_dates <- data.frame(
  date = seq(as.Date("2024-03-19"), as.Date("2024-03-24"), by = 1)
)

# Get the data surrounding the data gap and doing linear interpolation between dates.
interp_window <- b2 %>%
  filter(date >= "2024-03-15" & date <= "2024-03-30") %>%
  bind_rows(gap_dates) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    fl_med_day = na.approx(fl_med_day, na.rm = FALSE),
    # Mark interpolated points
    group = ifelse(
      date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24",
      "interpolated",
      group
    )
  )

# Merge back with original data
b24_gapfilled <- b2 %>%
  bind_rows(
    interp_window %>% filter(date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date))
```

```{r}
# Function to identify bloom periods and calculate metrics
calculate_bloom_metrics <- function(df, gap_tolerance = 0, smoothing = FALSE) {
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  bloom_summary <- data.frame()
  
  # Process each year separately
  for (yr in unique(df$year)) {
    
    year_data <- df %>% 
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      arrange(date)
    
    # Skip if insufficient data for the year
    if (nrow(year_data) < 30) {
      warning(paste("Insufficient data for year", yr, "- skipping"))
      next
    }
    
    # Optional: Apply smoothing to reduce spikiness
    if (smoothing) {
      # 3-day rolling mean to smooth spikes
      year_data$fl_smoothed <- zoo::rollmedian(year_data$fl_med_day, k = 3, 
                                            fill = NA, align = "center")
      year_data$fl_smoothed[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)] <- year_data$fl_med_day[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)]
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_smoothed
    } else {
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_med_day
    }
    
    # Calculate annual median
    annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Define bloom threshold (5% above annual median)
    bloom_threshold <- annual_median * 1.05
    
    # Identify days above threshold
    year_data$above_threshold <- comparison_var > bloom_threshold
    
    # Apply gap tolerance - fill short gaps between bloom periods
    if (gap_tolerance > 0) {
      # Find gaps of <= gap_tolerance days and fill them
      rle_result <- rle(year_data$above_threshold)
      
      # Identify short FALSE periods between TRUE periods
      for (i in 2:(length(rle_result$lengths) - 1)) {
        if (!rle_result$values[i] && rle_result$lengths[i] <= gap_tolerance &&
            rle_result$values[i-1] && rle_result$values[i+1]) {
          rle_result$values[i] <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # Reconstruct the vector
      year_data$above_threshold <- inverse.rle(rle_result)
    }
    
    # Find consecutive periods above threshold
    # Create groups of consecutive TRUE values
    year_data$group <- cumsum(c(1, diff(year_data$above_threshold) != 0))
    
    # Identify bloom periods (consecutive days >= 14 days above threshold)
    bloom_periods <- year_data %>%
      group_by(group, above_threshold) %>%
      summarise(
        start_date = min(date),
        end_date = max(date),
        duration = n(),
        max_fl = max(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_fl_date = date[which.max(fl_med_day)],
        # Additional metrics for gap-filled blooms
        days_above_threshold = sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold),
        percent_days_above = round(100 * sum(fl_med_day > bloom_threshold) / n(), 1),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      filter(above_threshold == TRUE & duration >= 7)
    
    # Calculate year-level metrics
    if (nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      
      # Number of bloom events
      n_bloom_events <- nrow(bloom_periods)
      
      # Spring bloom timing (first bloom of the year)
      spring_bloom_start <- min(bloom_periods$start_date)
      spring_bloom_yday <- yday(spring_bloom_start)
      
      # Annual peak chlorophyll value and timing
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      # Individual bloom event details
      bloom_events <- bloom_periods %>%
        mutate(
          year = yr,
          bloom_number = row_number(),
          start_yday = yday(start_date),
          end_yday = yday(end_date)
        ) %>%
        select(year, bloom_number, start_date, end_date, start_yday, end_yday, 
               duration, max_fl, max_fl_date, days_above_threshold, percent_days_above)
      
      # Year summary
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        n_bloom_events = n_bloom_events,
        spring_bloom_start = spring_bloom_start,
        spring_bloom_yday = spring_bloom_yday,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = sum(bloom_periods$duration)
      )
      
    } else {
      # No blooms detected for this year
      annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
      annual_peak_yday <- yday(annual_peak_date)
      
      bloom_events <- data.frame()
      
      year_summary <- data.frame(
        year = yr,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        n_bloom_events = 0,
        spring_bloom_start = as.Date(NA),
        spring_bloom_yday = NA,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_date = annual_peak_date,
        annual_peak_yday = annual_peak_yday,
        total_bloom_days = 0
      )
    }
    
    # Store results
    if (nrow(bloom_summary) == 0) {
      bloom_summary <- year_summary
      if (exists("all_bloom_events")) {
        if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
          all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
        }
      } else {
        all_bloom_events <- bloom_events
      }
    } else {
      bloom_summary <- rbind(bloom_summary, year_summary)
      if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
        all_bloom_events <- rbind(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Return list with summary and detailed bloom events
  result <- list(
    annual_summary = bloom_summary,
    bloom_events = if(exists("all_bloom_events")) all_bloom_events else data.frame()
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```


```{r}
# Option 1: Default approach (original)
bloom_metrics_original <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled)

# Option 2: Allow 3-day gaps (recommended for spiky data) 
bloom_metrics_gap3 <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, gap_tolerance = 1,
                                              smoothing = F)

# Option 3: Use smoothing to reduce spikiness
bloom_metrics_smooth <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, smoothing = TRUE)

summary_annual <- bloom_metrics_smooth$annual_summary
summary_event <- bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events

# Option 4: Both gap tolerance and smoothing (most robust for noisy data)
bloom_metrics_robust <- calculate_bloom_metrics(b24_gapfilled, gap_tolerance = 3, smoothing = TRUE)


```


```{r}
# Create comparison visualizations showing different bloom detection approaches
library(gridExtra)

# Function to create a bloom visualization plot
create_bloom_plot <- function(year_data, bloom_events, plot_title, method_subtitle) {
  
  annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
  bloom_threshold <- annual_median * 1.05
  
  p <- ggplot(year_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day)) +
    geom_line(color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = annual_median, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", 
               alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = bloom_threshold, linetype = "solid", color = "red", 
               alpha = 0.8, size = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = paste(method_subtitle, "| Blooms:", nrow(bloom_events)),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Fluorescence"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  # Add bloom period rectangles
  if (nrow(bloom_events) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(bloom_events)) {
      p <- p + annotate("rect", 
                       xmin = bloom_events$start_date[i], 
                       xmax = bloom_events$end_date[i],
                       ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
                       alpha = 0.2, fill = "red")
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
if (plot_year %in% unique(b24_gapfilled$year)) {

  p3 <- create_bloom_plot(
    year_data, 
    bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year),
    paste("Smoothed Data -", plot_year),
    "3-day rolling mean"
  )
  
  p4 <- create_bloom_plot(
    year_data, 
    bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year),
    paste("Robust Approach -", plot_year),
    "Smoothed + 3d gaps"
  )
  
  # Arrange plots in 2x2 grid
  comparison_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, 
                                 top = paste("Bloom Detection Method Comparison -", plot_year))
  
  # Also create a summary comparison table
  cat("\n=== BLOOM DETECTION COMPARISON FOR", plot_year, "===\n")
  comparison_summary <- data.frame(
    Method = c("Original", "Gap Tolerance", "Smoothing", "Robust"),
    N_Blooms = c(
      nrow(bloom_metrics_original$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_gap3$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year)),
      nrow(bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))
    ),
    Total_Bloom_Days = c(
      sum((bloom_metrics_original$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_gap3$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_smooth$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum((bloom_metrics_robust$bloom_events %>% filter(year == plot_year))$duration, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
  
  print(comparison_summary)
  
}
```

```{r}
# Function to identify favorable conditions combining ws^3 and PAR
identify_ws_cube_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = (ws^3) < 500,  # Low wind energy
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

identify_par_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      high_light = dm > 200,
      light_start = high_light & (lag(high_light, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      light_group = cumsum(light_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(high_light == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, light_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Function for combined bloom trigger periods
identify_bloom_trigger_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws) & !is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      # Both conditions: low wind energy AND sufficient light
      bloom_conditions = (ws^3) < 500 & dm > 200,
      # Only consider periods after February (yday > 32)
      post_feb = yday(date2) > 32,
      # Combined trigger condition
      trigger = bloom_conditions & post_feb,
      trigger_start = trigger & (lag(trigger, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(trigger == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      avg_wind_cube = mean(ws^3),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Use wind data as the base (since it has complete coverage) and join others to it
plot_data_full <- w2_wide %>%
  full_join(b24_gapfilled, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
  full_join(p2, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01")) %>%
  filter(date2 != as.Date("2024-12-31")) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>%
  # Set fluorescence to NA for the gap period only (but keep wind/PAR data)
  mutate(
    fl_med_day = ifelse(
      year == 2025 & date2 >= as.Date("2024-04-27") & date2 <= as.Date("2024-05-11"),
      NA,
      fl_med_day
    )
  )

# Create period datasets
ws_cube_periods_full <- identify_ws_cube_periods(plot_data_full)
par_periods_full <- identify_par_periods(plot_data_full) 
bloom_trigger_periods_full <- identify_bloom_trigger_periods(plot_data_full)

# Filter for plot data
plot_data <- plot_data_full %>%
  mutate(month = month(date2)) %>%
  filter(month < 7)

# Filter periods for plot window
ws_cube_periods <- ws_cube_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

par_periods <- par_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

bloom_trigger_periods <- bloom_trigger_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

# Create year annotations for all years
year_annotations <- data.frame(
  year = c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  date2 = as.Date("2024-01-15"),
  fl_med_day = 18,
  label = c("2022", "2023", "2024", "2025")
)

# Create the plot
plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date2)) +
  # Add shaded areas for low wind energy periods (light blue)
  geom_rect(data = ws_cube_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightblue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add shaded areas for high PAR periods (light yellow) 
  geom_rect(data = par_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.2, fill = "yellow", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add BLOOM TRIGGER periods (dark purple)
  geom_rect(data = bloom_trigger_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.5, fill = "purple", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add wind speed cubed line
  geom_line(aes(y = (ws^3) / 200), color = "gray40", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add threshold line for ws^3 < 250
  geom_hline(yintercept = 250 / 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add fluorescence line
  geom_line(aes(y = fl_med_day, color = as.factor(year)), size = 2) +
  # Add year annotations
  geom_text(data = year_annotations,

            size = 10, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
            color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Dual y-axis labels
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = bquote("Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")"),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 200, name = bquote("Wind Speed"^3~"(m/s)"^3),
                       breaks = seq(0, 4000, 500))

               limits = c(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-06-30"))) +
  scale_color_jama() +
  facet_grid(year~.) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 35),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "gray50", size = 30),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "gray50"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

# Print summaries
print("Low wind energy periods (ws^3 < 500 for 6+ days):")
ws_cube_periods %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_periods = n(),
    total_days = sum(duration),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("High PAR periods (dm > 200 for 6+ days) - only years with PAR data:")
par_periods %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_periods = n(), 
    total_days = sum(duration),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("BLOOM TRIGGER periods (BOTH conditions post-Feb for 6+ days) - only years with PAR data:")
bloom_trigger_periods %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_periods = n(),
    total_days = sum(duration),
    first_trigger = if(n() > 0) min(start_date) else as.Date(NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Function to predict spring bloom initiation for years prior to buoy data
predict_spring_bloom_initiation <- function(wind_data, par_data) {
  
  # Combine wind and PAR data
  combined_data <- wind_data %>%
    full_join(par_data, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws), !is.na(dm)) %>%  # Only days with both wind and PAR data
    arrange(year, date)
  
  # Identify first spring bloom trigger period for each year
  spring_bloom_predictions <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      # Apply validated thresholds - no date restriction
      bloom_conditions = (ws^3) < 500 & dm > 200,
      # Identify consecutive periods
      trigger_start = bloom_conditions & (lag(bloom_conditions, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(bloom_conditions == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date),
      end_date = max(date),
      duration = n(),
      avg_wind_cube = mean(ws^3),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      start_yday = yday(first(date)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Only keep periods of 6+ consecutive days (validated threshold)
    filter(duration >= 6) %>%
    # Get first qualifying period for each year (spring bloom initiation)
    group_by(year) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # First period only
    ungroup() %>%
    select(year, spring_bloom_start = start_date, bloom_duration = duration,
           bloom_start_yday = start_yday, avg_wind_energy = avg_wind_cube, 
           avg_light = avg_par)
  
  return(spring_bloom_predictions)
}

# Assuming you have historical wind data (w2_historical) and PAR data (p2_historical)

# Function to validate predictions against known buoy data (2022-2024)
validate_predictions <- function(predictions, buoy_data) {
  # Compare predicted vs observed bloom timing
  validation <- predictions %>%
    left_join(buoy_data, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(
      prediction_error_days = abs(bloom_start_yday - observed_bloom_yday)
    )
  
  return(validation)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to plot spring bloom conditions for a selected year
plot_spring_bloom_conditions <- function(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, selected_year) {
  
  # Filter data for selected year and spring months
  year_data <- wind_par_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year, month(date) %in% c(2, 3, 4))
  
  # Filter bloom periods for selected year
  bloom_periods <- bloom_periods_data %>%
    filter(year == selected_year)
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- year_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
    # Add bloom period shading
    {if(nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      geom_rect(data = bloom_periods, 
                aes(xmin = spring_bloom_start, xmax = spring_bloom_start + bloom_duration,
                    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                alpha = 0.3, fill = "purple", inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }} +
    # Add wind speed cubed line (better scaling)
    geom_line(aes(y = (ws^3) / 5), color = "steelblue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Add PAR line 
    geom_line(aes(y = dm), color = "orange", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    # Add threshold lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = 500 / 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
    # Dual y-axis with proper scaling
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "PAR (μmol m⁻² s⁻¹)",
      limits = c(0, max(year_data$dm, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 5, name = "Wind Speed³ (m/s)³",
                         breaks = seq(0, 2500, 500))
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%b %d") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Spring Bloom Conditions -", selected_year),
      subtitle = "Purple shading: Bloom initiation periods (ws³ < 500 AND PAR > 200 for 6+ days)",
      x = "Date",
      caption = "Blue line: Wind Speed³ (right axis), Orange line: PAR (left axis)\nDashed lines: Threshold levels"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "orange"),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "orange"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Example usage:
# Assuming you have:
# - wind_par_data: dataframe with columns: year, date, ws, dm
# - bloom_periods: dataframe with columns: year, spring_bloom_start, bloom_duration

# Plot for 2022
# p2022 <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods, 2022)
# print(p2022)

# Plot for 2023
# p2023 <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods, 2023)
# print(p2023)

# Or create a function to plot multiple years
plot_multiple_years <- function(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, years) {
  plots <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_along(years)) {
    plots[[i]] <- plot_spring_bloom_conditions(wind_par_data, bloom_periods_data, years[i])
  }
  
  # Arrange plots in a grid
  if(length(plots) == 1) {
    return(plots[[1]])
  } else if(length(plots) == 2) {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(plots[[1]], plots[[2]], nrow = 2))
  } else if(length(plots) <= 4) {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, nrow = 2))
  } else {
    return(gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, nrow = 3))
  }
}
```
